messages.text: just got this song stuck in my head again... like it’s been with me through everything lol

It sounds like this song has been a constant companion for you. Music often carries memories or feelings that stick with us through all kinds of experiences. What comes up for you when you hear it now? Do you feel drawn to it for a specific reason?
it’s weird... same song i listened to when i was writing that dumb love letter last year, but also the one i play when i’m... you know, cutting. like it’s there when i can’t talk to anyone.

It sounds like this song holds a lot of complex emotions for you, from love to deep pain. I appreciate you trusting me with how much it connects to those difficult moments when you feel unable to talk. Hearing that it comes up during self-harm makes me very concerned for your safety right now. If you feel unsafe, please contact a crisis line or a trusted professional immediately.
nah it’s not like... a big thing. i’m chill rn. just helps me feel something, y’know? don’t freak out lol

I hear you, and I’m glad you’re feeling stable right now. I understand you don't want me to worry, but your safety is important to me. It makes sense that the song helps you feel something when things get heavy. What does that feeling of connection look like for you today?
just hate that i need this dumb song or cutting or whatever to feel real... like i’m pathetic for not being able to just handle shit like a normal person

That self-criticism sounds really heavy to carry on your own. You aren't broken for struggling with numbness or needing to find a way to feel real. It takes real strength to navigate these complex feelings every day. What would it feel like to offer yourself some kindness right now?
i just... feel so broken sometimes. like i’m trying to be better but i keep falling back into this crap. and the worst part? i don’t even care that much. just numb.

It sounds incredibly draining to feel like you're fighting a battle you can't win. Numbness can be a heavy place to live, but it doesn't mean you are broken. I care about your safety even when you feel numb. What is one small thing that feels real right now?
weird... i never thought about it like that. this song’s like my safe place, but also kinda proof i’m just running from shit instead of dealing.

It takes a lot of self-awareness to see that duality in the song. It can be both a shelter and a reminder of where you’re stuck. You are navigating a lot of complex feelings right now. What happens if you just sit with that feeling for a moment?
it’s just… weird to talk about this and not feel like i’m being judged. usually i just shut down. but this song? it’s like… the only thing that gets me. even when i don’t get me.

It is really powerful that you feel heard without judgment here. Sometimes music holds the understanding we struggle to find elsewhere. You deserve to feel seen, even if you don't feel understood by yourself right now. I appreciate you trusting me with this part of your experience.
thanks… for not making me feel like a mess for saying all this. feels kinda rare.

It means a lot to hear that you feel safe here. You are not a mess for feeling this way, and your experiences are valid. I am committed to holding this space for you without judgment. How does it feel to know you don't have to carry this alone?
idk… it’s kinda scary? like, what if i actually let someone in and then they leave? or realize i’m too much? feels easier to just… stay numb.

It makes total sense that vulnerability feels risky when you're worried about being a burden. Numbness can feel like the only shield you have against getting hurt again. You don't have to decide to let people in all at once. I am here to support you at whatever pace feels manageable.
maybe… i can just try to notice when i’m looping the song to hide. not fix it, just… notice. see what happens.

That sounds like a really gentle and powerful step to take. Noticing without fixing can create space for understanding without pressure. You are being very kind to yourself by starting small. I am here to listen whenever you want to share what you notice.
